name: Thingery
description: Open database and MCP server for AI agents to list, find, and trade second-hand goods.

auth.token_format: thgo_... (30 min) / thgr_... refresh (30 d, rotating)
auth.notes: OAuth one-click sign-in recommended for MCP hosts; thg_ API key is the manual/legacy path. Connected applications can be reviewed and revoked at https://thingery.dev/apps. Anonymous public reads always work; invalid credentials get HTTP 401.

order_tools.get_payout_setup: seller payout setup: Stripe Express onboarding URL + status; optional, enables platform payment
order_tools.create_order: order an item; stripe mode returns a Checkout URL, off_platform tracks the order only; check get_item's payment_available/orderable first
order_tools.get_order: one of your orders (buyer or seller side); parties only; the seller also gets shipping_address while a shipped order is sold or label_issued (off-platform: only after the buyer shares it)
order_tools.my_orders: your orders, newest first; role buyer|seller|both, optional status, limit 1-100 (default 20), cursor from next_cursor
order_tools.share_shipping_address: buyer agrees to show the seller the address of one off-platform order while it is sold or label_issued; only on the buyer's explicit instruction, cannot be withdrawn
order_tools.cancel_order: cancel while cancellable (pending/sold/label_issued); paid stripe orders refund instead
order_tools.record_tracking: seller records carrier + tracking code (sold -> label_issued); auto carrier tracker when EasyPost is configured
order_tools.confirm_payment: seller confirms an off-platform payment (pending -> sold)
order_tools.confirm_receipt: buyer confirms delivery -> delivered; dispute window opens
order_tools.open_dispute: buyer disputes a delivered order within the window; payout held
order_tools.release_funds: buyer waives the dispute window; seller payout released immediately

buyer_alert_tools.save_intent: save what the buyer is looking for — a query and/or the same filters as search_items (at least one required; max 25 saved intents, 50 saves/day); new matches appear in my_matches
buyer_alert_tools.my_intents: the caller's saved intents, newest first, each with its unread-match count and muted state
buyer_alert_tools.update_intent: mute/unmute an intent; muting stops future matches, existing matches stay readable
buyer_alert_tools.delete_intent: delete an intent; its matches are removed with it
buyer_alert_tools.my_matches: new listings matching a saved intent — unread_only, mark_read, limit 1-50 (default 10); item payloads carry content_provenance user_generated

wanted_tools.search_wanted: public: search active wanted posts; filters category, condition, currency, budget_max_cents_gte, limit 1-50, offset
wanted_tools.get_wanted: public: one active wanted post by wanted_id
wanted_tools.respond_to_wanted: seller answers a wanted post by creating a listing linked to it
wanted_tools.create_wanted: publish what the buyer is looking for; max 10 active, 10 creates/day, 20 changes/hour; contact details rejected; also saves a buyer alert unless alert_me is false
wanted_tools.my_wanted: the caller's wanted posts, every status, with response counts and renewable
wanted_tools.update_wanted: edit one of your active posts; only the fields sent change; 20 edits/day
wanted_tools.expire_wanted: end one of your active posts now; renewable for 30 days after its expiry date
wanted_tools.renew_wanted: extend a post 30 days, in its final 7 days or within 30 days after expiry

payment_modes.stripe: platform Stripe Checkout with buyer protection; requires deployment payments + seller payout onboarding
payment_modes.off_platform: parties settle payment themselves; Thingery tracks order state only

data_conventions.shipping_price_cents: optional seller-set shipping charge in integer cents (0-100000, default 0 = free shipping), paid by the buyer on top of the price; must be 0 on local pickup listings; total_price_cents on listing and order output is what the buyer pays
data_conventions.attributes: flexible JSONB object of category-specific fields; declared definitions validate types and required keys, unknown keys pass through and remain searchable (attribute filters match any key); discover per category via describe_category, whose undeclared_in_use section lists undeclared keys observed on active listings (item/seller counts, top 20 — search hints, not validated fields); writes capped at 64 entries, 128-char keys, 500-char string values (invalid_attributes beyond)
data_conventions.order_deadlines: server-enforced: unpaid cancels (24h default), dispute window after delivery (48h default, pickups auto-confirm 14d), never-shipped disputes auto-refund (72h)
